Broad donut volumes and rounded plum cap replace the flat fills and sharp point. Painted mass reads clearly.
One low plum/gold base and its front gold scallop badge remain; the exposed peg has its matching small shell.
Soft broad satin bands and clean plum separation fit the painted family; highlights remain somewhat glossy.
Whole toy and clear outer padding are present on native RGBA; no background remnants or detached source fragments.
The visible six rings rest as a readable continuous stack, but the absent seventh invalidates conservation against the intended object.
Rejected for wrong ring count. Painted quality alone cannot override topology or pass the source against the specific seven-ring design.
